name: Legion X

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Nudge up or down, +1 multiplier per step.

features.name: Infectious Wilds
features.description: Turn a low symbol wild across the middle reels.

review:
A Roman 5x3 that stacks three xMechanics. xNudge wilds slide into view, +1 per step; Infectious Wilds on reels 1 and 5 turn every copy of a random low symbol on the middle reels wild; and xWays on the outer reels reveal two to four matching symbols.

With two mechanics sharing the outer reels, the middle of the grid is where it all comes together. Extreme volatility, 31,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
